section_summaries.individual_presentation: 3 patients with severe oligozoospermia and 1 with azoospermia All patients presented with diarrhoea, with or without blood loss per rectum
section_summaries.individual_diagnostics: normal follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH), luteinising hormone, and testosterone plasma concentrations The diagnosis was established by colonoscopy within 7 days of presentation; all had negative stool cultures diagnosis was established by colonoscopy within 7 days of presentation; all had negative stool cultures
section_summaries.individual_treatment: interferon alfa at the daily dose of 3 MU, 5 days per week for two months
section_summaries.individual_outcome: recorded substantial improvements in sperm density and motility after two months’ treatment; 2 patients’ wives became pregnant
section_summaries.individual_limitations: None of the 23 patients had pre-existing inflammatory bowel disease that could have been exacerbated by NSAID ingestion
